name: Roughrider Exploration Limited
summary: Roughrider Exploration Limited, an exploration stage company, explores for and evaluates mineral properties primarily in Canada. The company explores for magnetite, copper, gold, and silver minerals. It primarily has an option to acquire 100% interest in the Empire Mine property that consists of 23 mineral claims and 57 fee simple crown grants covering approximately 15,000 hectares located in the Rupert District on northern Vancouver Island, British Columbia. The company was formerly known as Westham Resources Corp. and changed its name to Roughrider Exploration Limited in June 2014. Roughrider Exploration Limited was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
